_comment: 行业目录单一数据源：后端 app.py 与前端 app.js 必须共读本文件，不得再各自内嵌副本。匹配顺序即优先级，第一个命中者胜出。en 用词边界正则：token 以 * 结尾表示前缀匹配（manufactur* -> manufacturing），否则要求整词相等（ai 不匹配 Air / Painting）。zh 用子串匹配（中文无词边界）。大马商号多为巫英混排，故 en 里同时收 Malay 常用词。

industries.label: IoT & Smart Hardware Engineering
industries.sub: Overseas enquiries land in another time zone; firmware and drawings sit on one engineer's machine with no automated off-site copy; nobody answers technical questions after hours.

industries.label: IT, Software & AI Cloud Services
industries.sub: Work reaches customers from free mailboxes instead of a company domain; services run on one server with no SLA and no recovery in another location.

industries.label: Auto Parts & Hardware Wholesale
industries.sub: Enquiries after closing go unanswered and the order goes to the next supplier; the customer list leaves with the salesperson; paper delivery notes slow the accounts down.

industries.label: F&B & Cloud Kitchen
industries.sub: Night ordering and supply planning depend on hand messages between outlets; ingredient waste and complaint responses lag behind.

industries.label: Professional Corporate Services
industries.sub: Client documents move through personal free mailboxes; working papers sit on one employee's machine with no controlled access.

industries.label: Construction & Materials
industries.sub: Site sign-off paperwork stays on paper; payment collection and supplier coordination take weeks longer than they should.

industries.label: Cross-Border Logistics & Haulage
industries.sub: Customs and vehicle location questions arrive at night and cannot be answered at once; declarations are keyed in by hand from paper.

industries.label: Retail & Multi-store Chain
industries.sub: Traffic from public channels is never captured, so it cannot be sold to again; stock across outlets is not visible in real time.

industries.label: Manufacturing & Engineering
industries.sub: Raw material supply breaks without warning; workshop hours are lost to re-keying; production data stays on single machines.

industries.label: Wholesale & Distribution
industries.sub: Cross-border and cross-bank reconciliation is slow; customer leads leave when a salesperson leaves.
